mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TBL_INTERVIEW_REVIEW_M (user_sq, company_nm, job_nm, career_level, interview_dt, interview_stages, question_edt, difficulty_star, atmosphere_edt, result_cd, proposed_salary) VALUES (#{userSq}, #{companyNm}, #{jobNm}, #{careerLevel}, #{interviewDt}, #{interviewStages}, #{questionEdt}, #{difficultyStar}, #{atmosphereEdt}, #{resultCd}, #{proposedSalary})
mapper.select: SELECT i.*, u.user_nickname FROM TBL_INTERVIEW_REVIEW_M i LEFT JOIN TBL_USER_M u ON u.user_sq = i.user_sq WHERE i.interview_review_sq = #{interviewReviewSq}
mapper.update: UPDATE TBL_INTERVIEW_REVIEW_M SET interview_is_deleted_yn = 'Y' WHERE interview_review_sq = #{interviewReviewSq} AND user_sq = #{userSq}
UPDATE TBL_INTERVIEW_REVIEW_M SET interview_view_cnt = interview_view_cnt + 1 WHERE interview_review_sq = #{interviewReviewSq}
